_mode: off | dry_run | live - switched by the principal, never by code. dry_run: on each window's start Anansi calls ATI and LOGS the event, ATI's answer and the text it would send - nothing reaches the principal. live: the same, and the text is delivered through notify on live_channels - only when ATI succeeds; an ATI refusal is logged, never narrated. off: no connection is opened.
_switch_live: set mode to "live" (one edit). Takes effect on the next event - the handler re-reads this file every time - with no restart. Turning it off needs a restart of Anansi to close the connection.
transport: AgentMail WebSocket, wss://ws.agentmail.to/v0, Authorization: Bearer AGENTMAIL_API_KEY - an OUTBOUND connection, so nothing on this machine is exposed to receive it (a webhook would need a public URL)
_series: The 12 daily series created 2026-11-03 from config/ati/organ_clock_windows.json. An event from any other series is logged as ignored.
